# Data from Table FCP-I-1: Nonbanking Firms' Positions
# Units: millions of foreign currency units
# Source: Most authoritative (latest bulletin = May 1977) for overlapping data

# From treasury_bulletin_1977_03_page_135.txt (Table FCP-I-1):
# Dec. 1975: Belgian Francs=12,060, Canadian Dollars=10,371
# Mar. 1976: Belgian Francs=2,245, Canadian Dollars=10,724

# From treasury_bulletin_1977_04_page_137.txt (Table FCP-I-1):
# Mar. 1976: Belgian Francs=2,246, Canadian Dollars=10,724 (slightly revised Belgian)
# June 1976: Belgian Francs=16,408, Canadian Dollars=11,176

# From treasury_bulletin_1977_05_page_130.txt (Table FCP-I-1):
# June 1976: Belgian Francs=16,408, Canadian Dollars=11,175 (latest revision)
# Sept. 1976: Belgian Francs=13,327, Canadian Dollars=10,806

# Using the LATEST available data from May 1977 bulletin as authoritative source:
# Dec. 1975: BEF=12,060, CAD=10,371 (only in Mar bulletin)
# Mar. 1976: BEF=2,246 (Apr/May revision), CAD=10,724
# June 1976: BEF=16,408, CAD=11,175 (May revised)
# Sept. 1976: BEF=13,327, CAD=10,806 (only in May bulletin)

bef = [12060, 2246, 16408, 13327]
cad = [10371, 10724, 11175, 10806]

print('Belgian Francs:', bef)
print('Canadian Dollars:', cad)

import statistics

# Pearson correlation coefficient
n = len(bef)
mean_bef = sum(bef) / n
mean_cad = sum(cad) / n
print(f'Mean BEF: {mean_bef}')
print(f'Mean CAD: {mean_cad}')

cov = sum((b - mean_bef) * (c - mean_cad) for b, c in zip(bef, cad))
std_bef = statistics.stdev(bef)
std_cad = statistics.stdev(cad)
print(f'Sample stdev BEF: {std_bef}')
print(f'Sample stdev CAD: {std_cad}')

corr = cov / (std_bef * std_cad)
print(f'Pearson r = {corr}')
print(f'Rounded to 4dp = {round(corr, 4)}')
"

arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import math
import statistics

bef = [12060, 2246, 16408, 13327]
cad = [10371, 10724, 11175, 10806]

n = len(bef)
mean_bef = sum(bef) / n
mean_cad = sum(cad) / n

print('Data:')
for i in range(n):
    print(f'  {i}: BEF={bef[i]}, CAD={cad[i]}')

# Covariance numerator: sum of products of deviations
cov_num = sum((b - mean_bef) * (c - mean_cad) for b, c in zip(bef, cad))
print(f'Sum of cross products: {cov_num}')

# Denominator: sqrt of (sum of squared deviations BEF * sum of squared deviations CAD)
ss_bef = sum((b - mean_bef)**2 for b in bef)
ss_cad = sum((c - mean_cad)**2 for c in cad)
print(f'Sum sq dev BEF: {ss_bef}')
print(f'Sum sq dev CAD: {ss_cad}')
print(f'Sqrt product: {math.sqrt(ss_bef * ss_cad)}')

corr = cov_num / math.sqrt(ss_bef * ss_cad)
print(f'Pearson r = {corr}')
print(f'Rounded to 4dp = {round(corr, 4)}')

# Double-check using numpy if available
try:
    import numpy as np
    r_np = np.corrcoef(bef, cad)[0,1]
    print(f'numpy corrcoef: {r_np}')
except:
    pass
"
